title: Create a Space: capture on type, kit and accent cascade to Spotlight, Space and Website, abandoned claims keep their reminders

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03 04:42Z: styles cascade to Spotlight, Space and Website in the next screen; every follow-up email fires, especially abandoned ones; capture name and email before Save

detail: Three gaps in the signed-out flow (ADR-1933). The server draft saved only after Continue on the contact step: now it saves as soon as a name and a full address are typed (debounced, and by beacon when the tab goes), so an abandoned draft gets the 1h, 1d, 3d reminders. The Review and Publish screen made the Space without the hold's carry, so the claimed handle, Theme Kit and accent were lost there, and nothing read the accent anywhere: publishReview now passes the carry, and the Spotlight step turns the accent place into the kit's hex, written as the Space's brand colour before the theme default fills it, which the Space page, its Spotlight and the website all wear. Claim stamped the draft converted before anyone signed in, so a magic link never opened got nothing: the hold now carries the draft token (hold cap 12 to 13 keys) and /launch/claim stamps it on arrival. Phone-only drafts stay unsaved (email is the key, and SMS is parked). Also from Daniel's screenshot the same night: the builder preview for the Network kit wore the prototype's accents and the generic photos; it now reads the kit's four schemes (Marigold first) from lib/theme/network-kit.ts, wears the kit's photo library, Instrument Serif italic for the one-word voice, the round mark beside the wordmark, the arched hero picture and the contour lines (three new --pv keys: font-em, art, badge). Probe: node scripts/probes/create-space-cascade.mjs.
